[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Kulkis''' was a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Thaereian military]]<ref name="the best defense" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|Nightwing}}</ref> As a test of resolve, Kulkis drew a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] against the Thaereian military [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Nightwing]] and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by him. A [[The Best Defense|short story]] depicting Kulkis' death at the hands of Nightwing was posted on the [[Cularin holonet node]] by an unspecified party; according to the story Kulkis had a reputation for cruelty and was in charge of the ''[[Bravedawn]]'', large troop [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. Many speculated that the story was written by [[Osten Dal'Nay]] of the [[Cularin Militia]]<ref name="the best defense" /> and that Dal'Nay was the true identity of Kulkis' killer Nightwing.<ref name="everyone's a critic">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050331b|text=Everyone's a Critic}}</ref>
